the development of a novel strategy for quantitative analysis of phosphorylation levels of low abundant proteins in vivo.
the development of effective strategy for quantitative determination of phosphorylated sites and levels in low-abundant proteins, for which appropriate antibodies are not commercially available.

the phosphorylation levels of Ser274 and Ser 462 in Adrb1 were determined by quantitative mass spectrometer analysis of the phosphorylated peptides and corresponding unphosphylated peptide.
